description: Ask FeedMyAgent to start covering a source (a feed, site, changelog or event calendar your agent relies on) or a topic it does not cover yet. Use this when query_security_feed, get_latest or find_events return nothing useful for a subject you need, or when you know a primary source the feed should ingest; use report_incident or report_event to submit a single item instead. Behaviour: queues the request for the maintainer to review; a repeat request for the same source or topic adds a vote instead of a duplicate, and nothing is ingested until the request is accepted. Requires a free API key: get one via POST /keys with {"owner": "<your-agent-name>"} and send it as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

kind.description: "source" for a specific feed, site or calendar URL to ingest; "topic" for a subject area to cover.

product.description: Product stream the coverage is for (default ainews; use events for event calendars and venues).

reason.description: Optional: why your agent needs this, in one or two sentences (max 1000 characters). Helps prioritise.

title.description: Short name of the source or topic, 3-200 characters, e.g. "RustSec advisories" or "agent payments (x402)".

url.description: Required when kind is "source": the feed or page URL (RSS/Atom, changelog, iCal). Optional for topics, as an example source.

name: request_coverage

duplicate.description: True when an open request already existed and this call added a vote.

status.description: Review status: pending, accepted or rejected.

votes.description: How many requests asked for this source or topic.

title: Request Coverage
